If you could send a message to yourself on your first day on ENI, what would it say?

“Bookmark the explorer.”

如果能给刚加入 ENI 第一天的自己发一条消息，你会说什么？

轮到你了。以“亲爱的第一天我……”开头 👇

items.text:
🚀 ENI × Sonvia | Ecosystem Partnership

ENI is expanding its Web3 ecosystem through a new partnership with @Sonvia_ai , an AI-native platform transforming AI-generated music into ownable, tradable, and licensable digital assets. 🎵

Together, we'll explore new opportunities
items.zh:
🚀 ENI × Sonvia｜生态合作

ENI 正通过一项新的合作拓展其 Web3 生态。合作方 @Sonvia_ai 是一个 AI 原生平台，可将 AI 生成的音乐转化为可拥有、可交易、可授权的数字资产。🎵

items.text:
🤝 Excited to partner with Sonvia!

Together, we're exploring how ENI's high-performance blockchain infrastructure can unlock new possibilities for AI-powered music assets and the digital music economy.
items.zh:
🤝 很高兴与 Sonvia 达成合作！

我们正共同探索：ENI 的高性能区块链基础设施，如何为 AI 驱动的音乐资产和数字音乐经济打开新的可能。

items.text:
The architecture behind the future of enterprise Web3 is here.

ENI Matrix = Mainnet + Hub + AppChains, powered by a Hyper-ordered Parallel Engine for real-time settlement at infinite scale.

This isn’t a chain. It’s the operating system for the next economy. 🔧⚡

🌐
items.zh:
企业级 Web3 的未来架构，已经到来。

ENI Matrix = 主网 + Hub + AppChains，由超有序并行引擎驱动，可在无限规模下实现实时结算。这不只是一条链，而是下一个经济体的操作系统。
